questions.stem: A 62-year-old male patient is having complaints of loss of vision in the form of a curtain coming down in front of the right eye. He has a history of 2 episodes of strokes, after which he has left-sided sensory and motor loss limited to the face and neck. Which of the following blood vessels might be stenosed in this case?

options.label: C
options.text: First part of the left subclavian artery
